acquisition_method.evidence: MS data were acquired in a data-dependent strategy selecting up to top 10 precursors based on precursor abundance in the survey scan (350-2000 m/z).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The final protein concentrates kept in the Microcon device were mixed with 100 μL of UA buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide and incubated in the dark for 20 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The final protein concentrates kept in the Microcon device were mixed with 100 μL of UA buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide and incubated in the dark for 20 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin (sequencing grade, Promega) was added onto the filter and the mixture was incubated for 18 h at 37°C.

fragmentation_method.evidence: HCD MS/MS spectra were acquired with a target value of 50 000 and resolution of 15 000 (400 m/z).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: LC-MS/MS analyses of peptide mixtures were done using RSLCnano system connected to Orbitrap Elite hybrid spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free quantification using protein area calculation in Proteome Discoverer was used (“top 3 protein quantification”).
